note: Discovery list for this tier. The listing used to come from the GitHub contents API, which is rate limited to 60 requests/hour unauthenticated; a refusal there silently emptied the catalog. This file is fetched from the raw CDN and is also bundled inside the installed uplift package, so a box with no network at all still knows what its own version shipped. Keep it equal to the directory: tests/test_curated.py pins it.
